first.rationale: Onboarding completion and activation are both declining, and prior evidence indicates that shortening onboarding and reducing signup friction improved completion, time-to-value, and first-week activation for self-serve/SMB accounts. This directly addresses two current problems while supporting sustainable qualified revenue rather than relying on price concessions. Verify the two closely related records before committing to confirm the applicable segments, intervention details, and durability of the effects.
